attend.question: How do I attend the LIVE session?
attend.answer: The workshop runs for 3 days — {{workshop.dateRangeLong}}, from {{workshop.sessionTime}} each day. Every session is LIVE on Zoom with Coach Abhishek Ranjan — not pre-recorded. After registration you'll receive a confirmation with all the details, and the joining link is shared in our WhatsApp community group before the first session begins.

registrationClose.question: When does registration close?
registrationClose.answer: Registration closes on {{countdown.closesText}} — a few hours before the first session begins. Seats at this price are limited, so we recommend registering early to avoid missing out.

price.question: Why is it priced at {{registration.currency}}{{registration.price}} when it's worth {{registration.currency}}{{registration.originalPrice}}?
